scope: Read-only source review only. No tests, host/provider/DB/browser calls, or private uploaded document reads.

blocking_finding.detail: runWatch is serialized by the watch unit flock, but cli.mjs import and accept-reviewed call importCandidate/acceptReviewed without acquiring the same flock. Concurrent CLI mutation and scheduled run can read the same old state.json and atomically overwrite each other, losing a candidate, review decision, or successful status transition.
blocking_finding.required_resolution: Acquire the shared .run.lock in every mutating CLI path (run/import/accept-reviewed), or provide and pin an administrative wrapper that is the mandatory invocation path. Keep status read-only/unlocked. Add a concurrency regression proving serialization.

reviewed_properties.provider_scope: 15 registered documents: 2 Ozon and 13 WB; no provider credentials. Shared acquisition is HTTPS-only with public-address pinning, accepted host checks, TLS, redirect cap 3, 20-second timeout and 25MiB artifact cap.
reviewed_properties.identity_validation: Common Ozon requiredServerIdentity string check is bypassed only for acquisition due :443 normalization; watch immediately validates canonical HTTPS origin/path, no credentials/query/hash and every advertised OAS3 server, then title/parser/inventory. This ordering is fail-closed.
reviewed_properties.storage: SHA256-addressed bounded blobs/inventories/diffs; 40MiB state budget; 3GiB disk floor; old snapshots are retained. Quota/fetch/validation failures preserve prior current and report degraded.
reviewed_properties.freshness: Fresh requires recent automatic success, never owner-supplied acceptance. Stale or partial source coverage returns DEGRADED; status recomputes state on GET/HEAD rather than serving a static green.
reviewed_properties.runtime_boundary: No code/catalog/API adapter mutations. Owner-supplied files become candidates; only exact-digest administrative acceptance can mark OWNER_SUPPLIED_REVIEWED, and that does not fabricate automatic freshness.
reviewed_properties.service_isolation: Dedicated systemd user; separate six-hour oneshot watch and loopback GET/HEAD status service. No LLM/Telegram/DB/provider credentials in application bundle.

additional_risks: accept-reviewed is digest-specific and outside HTTP, but the state has reviewer origin/time, not an explicit reviewer identity or ticket field; deployment should rely on a tightly controlled operator account and audit invocation.
No snapshot garbage collection is implemented. This preserves the stated no-deletion invariant but eventually causes a bounded-state-budget degraded condition after enough distinct updates.
test_review: The synthetic tests cover registry cardinality, Ozon :443 normalization and wrong origins, scheduled updates/diffs, blocked-source backoff with last-good preservation, WB completeness, freshness, exact-digest review, invalid identity, corrupt snapshots, quota exhaustion, symlinks, and read-only status routing. They do not cover CLI/watch concurrency; add this when fixing the blocker.
deployment_gate: Do not deploy mutating CLI operations until shared locking is implemented or the mandatory external flock wrapper is pinned and documented. Synthetic CI must pass; no production egress or upload is implied by this source review.
